AEO / GEO · Content audit

Answer Readiness Lab

I built a lab to help content teams see whether a web page answers real customer questions. It shows the supporting text and gives editors a specific change to try.

Independent project

The problem

A pricing page can mention a 14-day trial while leaving readers unsure when they can cancel. The answer may exist in Terms, several clicks away. Answer engine optimization (AEO) starts with clear answers to questions like this. Generative engine optimization (GEO) also asks whether important facts have sources that AI systems can cite.

The decision

I linked each finding to evidence so editors can check it before changing the page. The sample compares the same questions before and after a fix. The URL audit uses OpenAI web search and labels reports based on excerpts. Search ranking and actual AI citations require separate measurements.

What you can try

Try the six sample questions without a key, or paste page text to find supporting passages. To audit a live page, enter its URL and use your own OpenAI API key. Choose GPT‑6 Luna, GPT‑6.1 Terra, or GPT‑6.2 Sol, depending on your project’s access. The shared skill also works with drafts in Codex and Claude Code.
